_comment: Edit this file to update the strip at the top of the site. Nothing else needs touching. Push it and the page picks it up.
_testers: How many people are opted in to the closed test right now.
_betaStartDate: null until the closed test actually opens, then 'YYYY-MM-DD'. The 14 day counter works itself out from this.
_betaExpected: Free text shown while betaStartDate is null. Set to null to say nothing about timing.
_showDownloadCount: false hides the alpha download numbers and shows a plain line instead.
